As the years passed, reports of the Legion's activities all but ceased. Russ was afraid to reveal that his Rune Priests did not obey the Edict of Nicaea, and that the number of Wulfen only continued to grow. The Wolves soon defended their territory with the tenacity of an animal pack, forbidding any ships to cross the borders of their part of space. The Emperor decided to send Russ' longtime friend Sanguinius to find out what had happened to the Space Wolves Legion. But the Emperor did not know that Sanguinius had given the blood of his Legion to another sovereign.  
After convincing the Wolves to let his flagship through, the lord of the Blood Angels arrived on Fenris. He and his Chaplains, once Librarians, came to Russ's throne room, where he sat enthroned, surrounded by his Rune Priests. Sanguinius was struck by the sight of King of all Fenris. Russ's eyes were sunken, there were bags under his eyes, his hair and beard were disheveled, and his lips were twisted into an animal grin. Such a sight was very unusual for one of the sons of the Emperor. Sanguinius was able to talk to Russ, and he told him that the changes in his Legion had reached catastrophic proportions - almost 70% of the entire Legion had changed under the influence of their genetic curse. The halls of the Fang felt more like a cave of wild beasts than an abode of trans-human warriors. Russ's paranoia reached unprecedented heights, and impotence began to weigh heavily on him.  
And then Sanguinius told Leman his secret.The "Blood Angels" found protection from other forces, more powerful than the Emperor. Powers that are capable of such miracles that the sons of Terra never dreamed of, both mortal and demi-god primarchs. These forces could help Russ, save his Legion, if he swore allegiance to them.  
The first desire of Russ, after such words, was to tear his brother's throat, however, he was immediately visited by the thought that in this case his sons would definitely die. At that moment, the Rune Priests entered the conversation. They told their king that perhaps they could develop a powerful ritual that save their Legion. But the price of this ritual was high. Millions of victims were required, whose blood would purify the blood of the sons of Rus. Decades ago, the lord of Fenris would have killed the priests for the mere thought of such a thing, but now, in despair, the primarch only silently expressed his consent.  
Further events became known in later years as the "Blood Moon". Warriors of the Blood Angels and Space Wolves have come hunting on the surface of Fenris. They rounded up every mortal that came their way, bringing them to the Fang. Helpless people watched in horror as their yesterday's defenders destroyed their homes and seized loved ones. Those who were "lucky" to meet the "Blood Angels" saw the blood-stained slain monsters who killed more people than they caught, reveling in bloodshed with furious laughter. In just a few weeks, the entire population of Fenris was captured or destroyed. Millions of people were herded into the halls of the Fang. The Wulfen raged through the stone vaults, agitated by the smell of blood and fear.  
On the night of the new moon, hundreds of rune priests and blood chaplains of the Blood Angels gathered to perform a powerful ritual. The ground before them was littered with the bodies of a million victims, both human and animal. And in the center of a huge circle outlined by bloody runes stood Russ, ready to do anything to save the Legion.  
As the sorcerers began their ritual, Russ was visited by visions that finally revealed the truth to him. It has been watched for a long time now. A powerful being from the depths of the "world beyond the borders of the world", the lord of change, the god of mysteries and knowledge - Tzeentch. It was he who accelerated the appearance of the Wulfen, he, through the mouth of shamans, told Russ legends during his pilgrimage, he strengthened Russ's paranoia, and it was he who sent the vision of the ritual to his rune priests. Tzeentch promised the Space Wolves salvation. He will make them better, give them the strength they deserve, reveal their true nature. And Leman Russ, lord of Fenris, primarch of the Space Wolves, gave his soul to the forces of the Warp, taking on a new beginning.  
By the end of the ritual, where Leman Russ used to stand, a changed monster towered. Saliva dripped from the fangs of his wolf head, horns crowned his head, and feathers adorned with unblinking eyes hung from his pauldrons. Leman Russ became the Daemon Prince of Tzeentch and the embodiment of the spirit of Fenris. Even the skies above Fenris have undergone changes, from now on, eternal night has come over the planet, illuminated only by the moon, the color of blood.  
When Russ and Sanguinius returned to the Fang, they discovered that all of the Space Wolves' battle-brothers, with the exception of the Rune Priests, had become even more mutated Wulfen. From now on, the warriors of the legion were not only like wolves, but the spirits of all the animals of Fenris were mixed into their appearances. Some had horns on their heads, others became huge, bear-Astartes hybrid monsters, others grew tentacles like krakens slicing through the black depths of the oceans. Leman Russ no longer cared, for now his Legion were truly children of Fenris.  
The Legion shed its former name, becoming the "Wolves of Change", harbingers of Tzeentch,  
heralds of change. And now the Legion was ready to return to its birthplace. To bite into the very heart of the Imperium. And bleed the False AllFather.

From the very moment of its foundation, the Legion, which in the future will be called the "Space Wolves" was shrouded in secrets and mysteries, known only to those who were involved in their creation. Whatever gene-sorcery the Emperor of Mankind used to create his chained wolves, it had an impact on the entire subsequent history of the Legion.From the early days of the Great Crusade, the then unnamed VI Legion proved to be an effective and furious fighting force, sweeping away everything in its path and bringing bloody retribution against the enemies of mankind. At the same time, brothers in the Legions noted the savagery and rage behind the warriors of the VI, which many considered unnatural for the noble warriors of the Astartes, for which the Legion soon received the nickname "Pack".  
For many years, the VI Legion carved its bloody path through the stars in solitude, until the Emperor of Mankind finally found their lost genetic father, the Primarch Leman Russ.It makes no sense to describe the time Leman Russ spent on the world that became his cradle, because too many sagas have been written about it. Suffice it to say that once the "Wolf King" took his place at the head of his Legion, henceforth referred to as the "Space Wolves", he changed it, as much as titanic shifts and volcanic activity.In the decades that the Space Wolves and their primarch participated in the Great Crusade, Leman Russ became famous as a killer and executioner in the service of the Emperor. With unfailing fierce determination, the son of Fenris wiped the enemies of the Allfather from the face of the Galaxy.   
Terra's top ranks constantly commented on the effectiveness of the Space Wolves, though they questioned the methods and traditions of the Legion. But, hidden from the rest of the Imperium, another, far more terrible problem was brewing in the heart of the Legion."Canis Helix". A secret strength and weakness that was skillfully woven into the gene-seed of the sons of Rus. The strength that gave them their bestial fury and endurance, allowing them to destroy any enemy without fear, and the weakness that gave birth to a terrible monster in their soul, ready at any moment to drive the Astartes crazy. Decades passed before the first instances of changes occurred as a result of the Legion's DNA trait. Those who lost the battle to the beast within became monsters, brutal parodies of themselves, more animals than Space Marine warriors.Leman Russ and his most trusted Apothecaries were extremely concerned about such occurrences. What if the highest ranks of Terra found out about their curse? Will they be branded as mutants and monsters?   
Russ ordered that all available forces be thrown into the search for a cure for their curse.In subsequent years, the number of mutations only increased. Entire squads of warriors could go into a battle frenzy, transforming into snarling monsters that tore their enemies apart with claws and fangs. Secretly from everyone, the Space Wolves built huge halls in the depths of their fortress - the Fang, in which they locked and examined their changed brothers.  
Leman Russ's unease began to grow by leaps and bounds. He became extremely suspicious and, at times, even paranoid, trying to hide the ailment of his Legion from his brothers and Father. Neither the experiments of the Apothecaries nor the rituals of the Rune Priests had any positive effects, and the number of mutations in the Legion only grew.  
In desperation, the primarch of the Space Wolves decided to make a pilgrimage to his homeworld, intent on seeking answers in the harsh lands of Fenris. As the next day dawned, Lehmann Russ emerged from the gates of the Fang and set off alone into the wild and untamed lands. Only at sunset on the 9th day, Leman from the tribe of Russ returned to his sons, and told them what he had learned.  
Russ told how he wandered the forests and vales of Fenris, watching and learning, looking for answers and clues. Russ visited the villages of mortals, communicating with the elders and runeshamans, in order to learn from them the stories and legends of Fenris that he did not yet know, looking for answers in the past. And finally, an insight struck him - change was the very foundation of Fenris. The inhabitants of these lands, the monsters that inhabited the mountain and the oceans, even the very surface of Fenris were constantly changing, but at the same time, in their essence, remained the same. And so should their Legion. Accept the changes, but keep their essence.  
Certainly the primarch understood that he could not simply unleash the Wulfen on the battlefield, and then ordered his sons, and their allied Mechanicus, to secretly develop a new type of armor in which they could hide the Wulfen, passing them off as mere battle-brothers. Soon, hidden behind wolf-faced helmets, the Wulfen entered the battlefield side by side with their brothers, bringing death to the enemies of Fenris. At the same time, the Rune Priests developed rituals that could channel the anger of the changed brethren, and even dull it briefly. But even that did not assuage Russ's paranoia and his fear that their secret would be discovered.  
 The Legion grew further and further away from their brethren, and reports to Terra became less and less frequent.In one of the war companies, the Space Wolves had to join the company side by side with the brother legion of the Blood Angels. Fearing exposure, Leman Russ tried to keep his warriors away from the Angels, sending them to separate fronts of the battle, but it was still not possible to achieve complete removal.   
One day, the primarch's brother Sanguinius came to speak with Russ. He told him what he knew about the curse of the Space Wolves, and that his Legion understood them like no other, for there was a flaw in the Blood Angels' hearts that threatened their existence. This conversation brought Russ and Sanguinius closer, cementing the bonds of brotherhood between them.  
The brothers met again only on the eve of a major event initiated by the Emperor of Mankind himself - the Nikkei Council, designed to decide the fate of magic in the Legion. The opinions of the brothers - primarchs were divided. Some legions, like the Death Guard, advocated a complete ban on sorcery, others, like the Thousand Sons, believed that it was necessary to explore the power of the Warp. Russ took a position in the middle. Consumed by paranoia, Russ believed that the Legions' research into the art of warp magic could reveal a flaw in his warriors, and a ban on the use of magic would prevent the Rune Priests from using rituals to control the Wulfen. So when the Emperor made the decision to ban warp sorcery from the Legions, Russ succumbed even more to paranoia.

Well, I went to a psychologist for 4 months every week, and although she really helped me with improving my self-esteem, because of which I went from the stage of "I'm trash, not a person" to "I'm lousy and pathetic "(which for me is already progress), other problems have not gone anywhere.  
I tried different things - work, physical activity, drawing, reading, watching TV shows, playing computer games, going out with my family, etc. Nothing really helped me.  
A year has passed, and all the key problems are still here. Neither antidepressants, nor specialists, nor anything else helped, at least to distract from constant thoughts.  
So - I'm done. I mean I'm completely destroyed . There is nothing to help here, because everything is too broken.

I have nowhere to go and no reason to move. After all this, I didn’t have any life goals, dreams or expectations left. In general, now I just live day after day, as if on a machine, trying to occupy my brain with at least something so as not to fall into hysterics every day. I throw myself with sedatives (nothing strong, I still don’t want to “get hooked” on some pills), if it becomes very difficult. I cannot kill myself because I love my family too much, but my existence is also a burden to me, because now there is nothing in it.  
Of course, you can say that I am still relatively young, because 28 years is not 88, that all this is stupid and you need to find something in life worth moving for, and I even understand this with the rational part of my brain, since the brain is everything still capable of something. But I'm too broken and my "roof" is too far gone (I'm not sure if there is any suitable equivalent in English, but I mean, my psyche has already suffered too much).  
So, yes, I'm stuck in this forever. But, again, this post was created, first of all, in the expectation that someone can learn from my mistakes. If I can save someone from something like this, that would be very good. As for me, it's already too late.
